name: Rebuild a website section in your Shopify theme with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild a website section in your Shopify theme with MiroMiro

### How it works
Turn a section of any live website into a Shopify theme section and upload it straight into your theme. **Set Website, Section and Store** holds the page, the section (`hero`, `header`, `features`, `pricing`, `testimonials`, `faq`, `cta` or `footer`), your store and theme ID. **Extract Section as Shopify** rebuilds the section in a real browser as an Online Store 2.0 `.liquid` section with its schema, styled like the original. **Upload Section to Shopify Theme** saves it as `sections/miromiro-<section>.liquid` through the Admin API. Then add it to any page from the theme editor. If a step fails, the workflow stops with Shopify's or MiroMiro's message. Failed MiroMiro calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.4 on n8n 1.123).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`, see https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
2. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
3. Open **Extract Section as Shopify** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
4. In Shopify, create a custom app with the `write_themes` scope. In **Upload Section to Shopify Theme**, create a Header Auth credential: name `X-Shopify-Access-Token`, value = its Admin API token.
5. In **Set Website, Section and Store**, set `store` (the part before .myshopify.com) and `themeId` (the number in the Edit code URL).
6. Click **Execute workflow**, then open the theme editor > Add section.

Each section costs 10 credits.

### Customization
Test on an unpublished theme copy first. To move a whole page, loop over the sections of the "Rebuild a whole page as Shopify sections" template. Replace the source site's text and images unless it is your own.

![The workflow, in case the preview does not load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoraiaBarroso/n8n-nodes-miromiro/main/docs/templates/rebuild-section-in-shopify.png)

parameters.url: =https://{{ $('Set Website, Section and Store').first().json.store }}.myshopify.com/admin/api/2026-07/themes/{{ $('Set Website, Section and Store').first().json.themeId }}/assets.json
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ asset: { key: 'sections/miromiro-' + $('Set Website, Section and Store').first().json.section + '.liquid', value: $json.code } }) }}

parameters.content:
## Choose the section and store

Set the page, section, store and theme ID in **Set Website, Section and Store**.

## Rebuild and upload

MiroMiro rebuilds the section as Liquid, and it is uploaded into your theme's sections folder.
